summary:
Turning messy data into clear decisions
I enjoy roles where I can keep learning, work closely with people, and turn data into clear stories. I like coaching teammates and presenting results to non-technical audiences.

preferences.looking_for:
A hands-on data role in a mission-driven organisation where I can keep building products and mentoring others.
Target industries: Research institutions, Educational institutions, Technology companies
I combine a research background with hands-on engineering experience, which lets me apply data science across very different domains.
Building new data products with visible results, and learning new technologies to solve them.
Subjects I can teach: Data Science, Statistics
preferences.avoid: Purely administrative roles with no hands-on contribution, or work focused solely on maximising revenue.
